test_title: PYST 64: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 18 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Identify the figure given in the options, which when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30e6cbee034aebda07fc4fd330b70fcc26fb6a178a89b9be3f0f802aa929961d.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The left diagonal elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

No change in the rest of the elements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24b561383bb24d85c9776ed0e422fe3a96cf35ef3164049494f8ad0ce3df75a0.png] 

2) Second box series →

The right diagonal elements shift clockwise subsequently.

No change in the rest of the elements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72af552717a9d5da66534ebb1983cbbae2f71fed25241c98ba23d86eed9e0b94.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dcc414b45cd90e1ccbd1767d9bdb14156b7d1846b4065cd3e4bfa9a90d9a517e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6ed191d86ac14a7bd47f59846567c4acfe7598bcb7269cb3e36207d2d88bda5.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
